name: Kill Jack
summary: In the twenties Jack ran a casino by the sea. The casino is gone. Jack is still dealing. KILL JACK is a first-person PSX horror blackjack roguelike: every chip on your side of the felt is one of your lives, every chip on his side is one of his. Ties go to the shotgun, each ante adds a house rule that stays for the rest of the night, and 35 charms let you bend the odds. Clear all six antes and Jack hands you the shotgun.
